aggregation: 32m average fractional count multiplied by native source-pixel area factor; approximate index
booking_validation: APPROXIMATE_SECTION_POINT_IN_WARD; checked against HMWSSB connection growth (independent_checks); tanker and billing data begin in 2022
boundary_vintage: Unverified historical 150-ward DataMeet layer; not current GHMC geography

comparison_sources.use: independent population sensitivity not ground truth
independent population sensitivity, incomparable without harmonization

connection_growth.basis: DERIVED (REAL billing counts, approximate section placement)
connection_growth.description: Spearman rank correlation, ward adjusted building trend vs growth of mean monthly HMWSSB domestic connections 2022 -> 2025 (sections placed on wards)

interpretation: Building-change signal; buildings are not households or population
limitations: Only 145 polygon features; layer is an incomplete historical 150-ward scheme.
Census placement is approximate (E2: Census 2011 via the rebuilt 2009 ward map); no exact-geometry join exists.
Open Buildings confidence is uncalibrated; Google documents positional/temporal jitter, tile seams, and missed small buildings.
32m aggregation bounds extraction; compare 16m/64m before treating small ranking differences as stable.
WorldPop's India raster host does not support range reads; the 1.84GB file was not downloaded.
GHS-POP grid epochs differ from 2016-2023; no multi-source agreement score is reported.
The connection check uses approximate section placement (about 80% of bookings) and 2022-2025, a later period than the 2016-2023 building trend.
population_projection: BLOCKED; no current household estimate is computed

stability.method: remove city-wide year shocks (cumulative median ward log change minus its linear trend), then least-squares trend per ward; STABLE_TREND if t >= minimum_trend_t
stability.replaced: CV of annual log change >= 0.25 (flagged all 145 wards)
stability.source_note: Google Open Buildings Temporal: aggregates like building count can be unstable (cloud cover, image misalignment, fewer Sentinel-2 frames in 2016-2017)
